_about: routing.json — the single source of truth for "what runs on what model". WS6a of epic #669 (#864). Pairs with the evidence-based eval loop (#865). DESCRIPTIVE today: records the CURRENT model of each agent (mirrors .claude/agents/*.md frontmatter) plus a `proposed` cheaper tier and the rationale. Render with `node scripts/gen-routing.mjs` (writes writeups/architecture/routing-registry.md) or `--check` (CI guard: fails on a stale registry OR a route whose tier drifts from the agent's real frontmatter). NEXT: a sync step that writes the chosen tier back INTO the consumers (agent frontmatter, pi models.json, workflow env) so this becomes PRESCRIPTIVE. Until then, changing a model still means editing the agent file; this is the map + the proposal, reviewed on the sweep and validated by the #865 scoreboard before any demotion. (Was routing.yaml; converted to JSON so the gen-routing.mjs guard needs zero deps — the check job never installs node_modules; #1062.)
_pi_reality: SUPERSEDED (#1669/#2161): the `pi` column below recorded the retired GLM-Coding-Plan era (#1409/#1421). As of #1669 the pi pipeline runs ENTIRELY on the Claude subscription — the mini's `claude` login works headless, so there is no cost reason to run GLM. The LIVE, editable knob for what the pi pipeline actually runs is .claude/pipeline-models.json (read at dispatch by scripts/resolve-pipeline-model.mjs); the `pi` values here are kept Claude-accurate so this registry doesn't contradict it, and the GLM eval history is preserved in the notes. If GLM (or another provider) is ever re-introduced per the #865 scoreboard, it changes there, not by editing workflows.
_tiers: Each tier maps to a concrete model per harness. out_per_mtok is the Claude baseline output price ($/Mtok) — the cost lever. pi_local = the local (~$0) option on the Mac mini (informational; the generator reads `pi`).

small.note: reports / triage / decompose — no code written. (pi ran GLM per #1409's eval; reverted to Claude sub #1669)

medium.note: most work. (pi ran GLM per #1421's eval; reverted to Claude sub #1669)

_routes: One entry per agent/flow. tier = what it runs on TODAY (must match the agent frontmatter — --check is the guard). proposed = where the cheap-but-good re-tiering would put it, pending the #865 quality measurement. Omit proposed to mean "no change proposed".

task-worker.why: writes code → PR; quality-sensitive — hold on Claude until #865 proves a cheaper model

task-orchestrator.why: reads epic → workstreams; no code written. Moved opus→Sonnet 5 on an N=4 decompose A/B (Sonnet 5 matched/beat Opus 4.8 on 3 of 4 real epics, ~5× cheaper, fewer NEEDS-SPLIT recursion rounds). Refines #824: the strong-but-cheaper model is a peer planner, not the blunt one that decision guarded against.

task-decomposer.why: LEAF test + split issues; no code written. Moved opus→Sonnet 5 with the orchestrator on the same N=4 A/B evidence. Refines #824.

red-team.why: security analysis, reports only — opus was overkill; moved to Sonnet 5 (no code written, daily deep sweep is the cost). Free win per #823/#824.

a11y.why: template review, reports only — Sonnet→Haiku (#1272/#823); reversible if the #865 scoreboard shows missed axe findings

frontend-review.why: convention review, reports only — Sonnet→Haiku (#1272/#823); reversible if it stops catching v3 names

simplify.why: simplification / code-smell review, reports-only + ADVISORY (never blocks). Judgment-heavy and false-positive-sensitive (a noisy taste call teaches people to mute the check), so Sonnet not Haiku — mirrors red-team's reports-but-judgment tier. Reversible via the #865 scoreboard if it proves noisy (#1576).

_overrides: Per-flow exceptions that pin an exact model regardless of tier. This is where a one-off flow declares itself VISIBLY instead of burying the decision in a branch.

overrides.why: SUPERSEDED by #1669: ran GLM (zai/glm-5.2) after #1409's eval matched engine ground truth at $0 marginal; reverted to the Claude subscription (haiku, the small tier) when the mini's `claude` login proved to work headless.

SUPERSEDED by #1669: ran GLM (zai/glm-5.2) after #1421's eval produced a correct house-style PR at $0 marginal; reverted to the Claude subscription (sonnet, the medium tier). Now matches the medium default, so this override is only kept as the recorded reversal.

_known_gaps: The top-level workflow loop (claude.yml, decompose-on-issue.yml, resume-on-comment, fix-ci-on-failure, a11y[-daily], frontend-review, red-team[-daily], gate-smoke, loop-station-advisor) is now PINNED to claude-sonnet-5 via `--model` in each step's claude_args (#1158, closing the earlier UNPINNED gap that let the action default to the older claude-sonnet-4-6). `--model` sets only the MAIN loop; Task-spawned sub-agents still resolve their own frontmatter model (task-worker = opus). OPEN: whether a sub-agent's `model: sonnet` frontmatter alias also resolves to sonnet-4-6 in the pinned action SHA — verify against a post-merge run's modelUsage and, if so, pin the full id in frontmatter too.
